findings.title: still present since round 1 — blur_gate.py setup errors exit 1 (gate-red) via traceback, violating the documented exit-2 contract; missing flag values silently ignored
findings.evidence: getpixel sampling unwrapped; `return 0 if ok else 1` is the only exit path; the docstring promises `Exit code 0 = gate green, 1 = gate red, 2 = usage/setup error.`; `if a == "--sigma" and i + 1 < len(sys.argv)` silently drops a valueless trailing flag.
findings.detail: A wrong-size image, changed view fit, missing file, or bad --sigma raises → Python exits 1, indistinguishable from a measured gate failure; unknown args accepted silently.
findings.recommended_fix: try/except around open/float/getpixel printing a setup error with sys.exit(2); assert img.size == (1280, 720); error on valueless flags and unknown args.
